title: Quick-Return Reduction (Returns & Exchanges)
content:
Customers who send a Returns & Exchanges return back quickly receive a reduction of the return shipping fee. It follows the calendar days from the order's delivered date to the parcel's first carrier scan.

| Days from delivered date to first carrier scan | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 5 or fewer | 2.00 USD |
| 6 to 10 | 1.00 USD |
| More than 10 | None |

The reduction is taken off the return shipping fee after the fee is rounded to the cent, and the fee is never below zero.

## Both sides of each threshold

| Days | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 5 | 2.00 |
| 6 | 1.00 |
| 10 | 1.00 |
| 11 | None |

Example (hypothetical): a 4.95 fee on a parcel first scanned 3 days after delivery becomes 2.95.
